balanced_noise.scope: Component gates and experiment records only. Convergence, physical extraction, durations and remaining experiments require separate assessment.

gauge.scope: Physical fields on the explicitly recorded time window at common exact saved times; no temporal interpolation. Nested nodal grids use exact restriction; regular half-cell grids use degree8 spatial interpolation. AF node has zero radial norm weight and is not a physical metric sample. Field errors supplement all-stage safety and every-accepted-step constraints.
gauge.coverage_note: Only common reported-time matches within1e-10 are compared. Older cumulative-clock frames can miss a requested tick by one RK step; none are shifted or interpolated in time. The integer-step clock repair is a separate source-bound change.

arithmetic.scope: Finite A=.1 pulse through1, full exact saved-time comparison and every-step/stage extrema. One timestep halving isolates a difference but cannot establish temporal order. Richardson estimates require the observed spatial regime and are reported alongside raw differences. Finest constraint floors and all failed gates remain visible; no long-duration or principal admission.

modes.scope: Discrete Jacobian on the full finite-grid phase. Compatible continuum weighted jets are not imposed; this does not prove or refute nonlinear continuum stability.

contents.scope: Supplemental Bondi-time gate for newly instrumented ABI17 trajectories; original acceptance gates stay unchanged.
contents.quantity: kappa of n_B in the unit-sphere conformal frame
contents.rationale: This bounds the logarithmic affine-rate error by1e-7 over the measured segment, without assuming cancellation between sampled values. It is sufficient and conservative; long-duration admission may instead require an accurately integrated absolute defect.
contents.predeclaration: Written before inspecting the ABI17 full-trajectory all-stage affinity results. Older sampled replays are not all-stage evidence.
